Hello Anna,

Thank you for your message about order SO-5005. The order has already been picked up on 20 November and is now in transit with our carrier, NordFreight, so we can no longer change the delivery address in our system.

We have asked NordFreight to redirect the parcel to Satamatie 2, Kemi. We will confirm whether the redirect has been accepted and send you the updated delivery estimate as soon as the carrier replies. If you have questions, please reply to this email or contact us at [PHONE_1].

Kind regards,
Customer Support

detail.result:
[{"runbook": "address-change", "score": 10.73, "text": "# Delivery address change

Applies when the customer wants to change where an order is delivered.

1. Before pickup: propose `update_delivery_address` (needs approval).
2. After pickup (`picked_up` event exists): the address cannot be changed in our system. Propose `contact_carrier` to request a redirect; NordFreight allows redirects while in transit, other carriers do not.
3. Confirm the new address with the customer in the reply.
"}, {"runbook": "late-delivery", "score": 1.98, "text": "# Late delivery

Applies when the promised date has passed and the shipment is not delivered.

1. Check shipment events. An `exception` event at a carrier hub means a carrier-side delay.
2. Carrier-side delay: contact the carrier (action `contact_carrier`) and ask for a new ETA. If the customer is a key account or the delay is more than 5 working days, propose `expedite_shipment` (needs approval).
3. Do not offer credits for carrier delays below 10 working days. Compensation above that needs a manager's approval and is out of scope for agents.
4. Tell the customer what happened, what we are doing and when we will update them. Do not promise a delivery date the carrier has not confirmed.
"}]
